const isPlainObject = (val) => {
  if (kindOf(val) !== 'object') {
    return false;
  }

  const prototype = getPrototypeOf(val);
  return (prototype === null || prototype === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(prototype) === null) && !(toStringTag in val) && !(iterator in val);
}
